name: Shrink Ray
description: Shrinks an enemy within %cast_range% tiles for %duration% turns, cutting %stat_reduction:pct%% from each of its attributes and %hp_reduction:pct%% from both its current and its maximum health.
details: Recasting shrinks the target again from its new size and refreshes the duration.
Everything taken is returned exactly when the beam wears off, whatever else has happened in between.

upgrade.summary: Takes %stat_reduction:pct%% of every attribute and %hp_reduction:pct%% of health.
